figurative_meaning_en: To mix indistinguishably; to become completely united
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের বন্ধুত্ব এতটাই গভীর যে দুধে জলে মেশা হয়ে গেছে।
সমাজে নতুনরা দ্রুত দুধে জলে মেশে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: Their friendship is so deep that they have mixed like milk and water.
Newcomers in society quickly blend in like milk and water.
note: This idiom draws from everyday rural imagery of milk and water mixing naturally, emphasizing harmony.
